snippet.title: Auto Ball Arena: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Auto Ball Arena is a chaotic physics auto battler. Build the ultimate warrior and send them spinning, bouncing, and slicing into battle! Featuring async-online multiplayer.
